name: Niwasaka Rira
source:
A shy and timid girl who wants to work at Cafe Caramella. She goes to the same academy as the [url=/c65580]protagonist[/url]. [url=/c65568]Richer[/url] is her childhood friend and goes wherever she goes - they are inseparable friends.

She loves rabbits and collects stuffed animals but is a bit uncomfortable with real-life, living rabbits.

A shy and timid girl who wants to work at Cafe Caramella. She goes to the same academy as the [url=/c65580]protagonist[/url]. [url=/c65568]Richer[/url] is her childhood friend and goes wherever she goes - they are inseparable friends.
